name: 子目標・案件・作業・手動から進捗の情報元を選ぶ設定
prompt:
Create one faithful Japanese-localized product UI screenshot of the progress-source selector in the supplied reference. Show the single selected state from the Japanese mock; this is one four-choice control, not separate variants.

Use one shallow horizontal composition. At the top-left show the small bold heading 「進捗の情報元」. Beneath it, place exactly four equal-width rounded selection cards in one row.

Card 1: outlined subgoal/triangle icon with a small lightning accent; bold label 「子目標」; muted sublabel 「自動で更新」.

Card 2: project/document icon with a small lightning accent; bold label 「案件」; muted sublabel 「自動で更新」.

Card 3: checked-task icon with a small lightning accent; bold label 「作業」; muted sublabel 「自動で更新」.

Card 4: simple person icon; bold label 「手動」; no sublabel. This fourth card is selected: use a thin green outline and very pale mint fill, matching the Japanese mock. The first three cards have white fill and a subtle light-gray outline.

Keep the four cards aligned, compact, and evenly spaced. Use the source for icon meaning and hierarchy, and the Japanese mock for exact text and selected green styling. Use Meiryo typography with a compact bold label and small 12/16 secondary text. No helper copy, buttons, page chrome, or extra controls. Fit the full control into a 4.79:1 frame with no blank bands.
reviewNotes: All four progress-source choices and Japanese labels are present; the first three show automatic updating and Manual is selected. The 2173x724 canvas is 3.00:1 versus the 813x174 source crop (4.67:1) and 680x142 mock (4.79:1), with broad blank bands above and below. Selected-state green follows the Japanese mock while the original is blue; icon geometry and exact typography remain unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
